question: C borrowed ₹6000 from D on 15 March 2023 at a simple interest rate of 10% per annum. C decided to repay the loan on 15 September 2023. How much total amount must C return to D?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Time duration from 15 March to 15 September is exactly 6 months (1/2 year).

Simple Interest = Principal × Rate × Time ÷ 100

Interest = 6000 × 10 × (1/2) ÷ 100 = ₹300

Total Amount = Principal + Interest = 6000 + 300 = ₹6300

**∴ The correct answer is ₹6300.**
